description: Held-out set for the statement/comparison selection rules. Every rule in the tuning set (data/retrieval_quality_cases.json) was written against net sales and revenue wording, so those scores are in-sample. These cases use metrics the rules never saw - gross profit, operating income, research and development expense, operating cash flow, total assets - quoted with the wording each filing actually uses. Labelling standard: the page must be the consolidated primary financial statement (statement of operations / balance sheet / cash flows), not a selected-financial-data summary, an MD&A reproduction, or a note. Labels were written before any scoring run. The attribute_headcount family has no held-out capacity: the corpus has five documents and the tuning set already covers a headcount question in every one.
